baseline_models.mechanism: B-th-th sends units outward, d-b-b gives them independent trajectories, and j-m-ʿ reverses that topology by bringing the dispersed plurality back together.

activation_trace.role: Literal dispersal supplies the outward phase of the reversible scatter/gather mechanism.
Literal creeping motion turns what is dispersed into many moving trajectories rather than inert inventory.
Joining what was separated supplies the inward reversal and makes dispersion recoverable.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists created realms, creatures, and a later ability to gather them.
changed_reading.after: The sign is controlled reversibility itself: life is released into many self-moving trajectories without ever leaving the capacity for recomposition.

baseline_models.mechanism: Creation activates prior measuring, will selects the moment, and capability executes what has been measured; gathering is therefore staged enactment rather than an appended display of force.

activation_trace.role: Prior estimating and measuring supplies a designed starting state for creation.
Will supplies the selective gate expressed by 'when He wills.'
Deliberative estimation links the designed creation to a deliberately timed gathering.
Effective capability supplies the execution of the selected and measured act.

changed_reading.before: Power is a general assurance that gathering is possible.
changed_reading.after: Power is the executable side of a measured design: specification, willing, timing, and realization form one chain.

baseline_models.mechanism: A visible sign is produced from life whose circulation can be hidden from sense: dispersal masks the total population, while gathering makes that latent totality legible.

activation_trace.role: The visible mark establishes legibility as the governing function of the ayah.
Wide dispersal explains why the total field of life is not available in one view.
Hidden circulation supplies life that is real and active even when its motion escapes perception.
Reassembly converts an imperceptibly distributed population into a manifest whole.

changed_reading.before: The created creatures are themselves an immediately evident sign.
changed_reading.after: The sign also lies in the tension between hidden distributed motion and the possibility of making its complete extent manifest.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier named day of gathering is followed immediately by two separated teams, so gathering does not merely reverse spatial dispersion; it exposes and sorts morally differentiated trajectories.

activation_trace.role: Rejoining the dispersed remains the focus anchor that context makes classificatory.
A designated day that gathers people supplies the event horizon for the focus gathering.
Two separated groups supply the sorting output produced within that gathering.

structural_cues: 42:7 names the day of gathering and then repeats 'team' for opposed destinations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: a gathering day yields two teams. Reader arrow: recomposition reveals and sorts prior trajectories. Live alternative: the team contrast may simply follow assembly without describing its function.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is the spatial reversal of creaturely dispersal.
changed_reading.after: Gathering is also diagnostic sorting: dispersed lives arrive together while their differentiated courses become publicly consequential.

context_deltas.mechanism: The unrealized option of making humanity one community distinguishes collection from homogenization: divine will can produce unity, yet gathering can retain plurality rather than erase it.

activation_trace.role: A gathered plurality or mixture lets collection preserve many members under one direction.
Repeated willing supplies the unrealized and realized alternatives that govern communal form.
Making something assume a state supplies the possible transformation of people into one community.
Making one supplies the homogenizing operation that the conditional presents but does not enact.

structural_cues: The unrealized one-community conditional in 42:8 follows the day-of-gathering scene in 42:7.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: God could make one community but instead selectively admits. Reader arrow: gathering is not identical to making-one. Live alternative: the two statements may concern unrelated horizons.

changed_reading.before: To gather the creatures is to collapse their dispersion into undifferentiated unity.
changed_reading.after: The gathering can hold a plural population together without making it homogeneous; collection and unification are distinct operations.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pairing supplies reproductive propagation, while rain revives vegetation and mercy is spread immediately before the focus; creaturely broadcast becomes a recurring wetting, propagation, and movement cycle across habitats.

activation_trace.role: Soft productive earth supplies the receiving habitat in which dispersed life can multiply.
Literal spreading supplies the ecological expansion from local generation into inhabited space.
Movement over land supplies the active population produced by the propagation cycle.
Joining one thing as a mate to another supplies the reproductive coupling behind proliferation.
Progeny supplies the generational multiplication that precedes spatial dispersal.
Vegetation issuing through rain supplies the material ecological response to descent.
Rain reviving dry pasture supplies the opening and renewal immediately upstream of creaturely broadcast.
Merciful tenderness names the beneficial release that the rain-and-spreading sequence enacts.

structural_cues: 42:28 immediately precedes the focus with descending rain and spreading mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: pairs propagate, rain yields vegetation, and mercy is spread before creatures are broadcast. Reader arrow: these form one recurring ecological pulse. Live alternative: spreading mercy may remain non-material and need not cause the life distribution.

changed_reading.before: The creatures are the result of a one-time primordial scattering.
changed_reading.after: Their broadcast can be read as a recurrent ecology: pairing multiplies life, measured rain reopens habitat, and moving populations spread through it.

context_deltas.mechanism: Expansion and constriction are paired controls, and unrestricted abundance is linked to terrestrial transgression; q-d-r in the focus therefore reads as calibrated governance of distribution and timing, not maximal force alone.

activation_trace.role: Capability remains the focus predicate but is reclassified by context as controlled deployment.
Expansion against contraction supplies one pole of resource modulation.
Constricting to a lesser measure supplies the counter-pole to expansion.
Abundant widening supplies the counterfactual condition that would overrun social limits.
Transgressing the limit supplies the harm prevented by calibrated release.
A determined amount supplies the measured dosage of descent.
Will selects the amount and aligns the local control loop with 'when He wills' in the focus.

structural_cues: 42:27 places measure, will, and earth two ayat before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: resources expand, constrict, and descend by measure because unlimited spread would provoke transgression. Reader arrow: the same control logic governs creaturely scatter and gather. Live alternative: q-d-r in 42:29 may retain only generic ability.

changed_reading.before: Gathering demonstrates an unrestricted capacity after unrestricted dissemination.
changed_reading.after: Dissemination and gathering are calibrated controls: power appears as giving each expansion, restraint, and convergence its fitting measure and time.

context_deltas.mechanism: Separation by dispute creates a 'between'; justice and gathering then bring distinct parties into one adjudicative relation without erasing their sides.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated members anchors the social mechanism in the focus gathering.
Splitting into parts supplies the disputed separation that gathering must address.
Justice in judgment supplies the rule governing the encounter of separated parties.
A connection standing between endpoints supplies the relational space across which gathering operates.
The explicit gathering between 'us' supplies the social and adjudicative realization of the focus verb.

structural_cues: 42:13-15 moves from a command not to divide, through actual division, to justice and 'God gathers between us.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: divided parties are addressed with justice and a promised gathering between them. Reader arrow: gathering creates a common forum for adjudication. Live alternative: the phrase may point only to the final gathering, not a general social mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The gathered beings are a biological or cosmological population.
changed_reading.after: They can also be parties separated by claims: gathering establishes the shared relation in which their difference can be judged.

context_deltas.mechanism: The post-focus ship sequence turns signs into a field of trajectories: motion depends on wind, will can remove that driver, moving vessels become fixed, and they may be destroyed; gathering can therefore activate as convergence or arrest of motion.

activation_trace.role: Creaturely movement supplies the focus-side kinetic state.
The gathering of force or flow supplies a possible control over distributed trajectories.
Flowing motion supplies the mobile sign that parallels moving creatures.
Will supplies the switch controlling the transition from movement to arrest.
Loss of motion supplies the first explicit reversal of a moving state.
Wind supplies the material driver whose removal arrests the vessels.
Fixity after movement supplies the resulting stationary state.
Destruction supplies the terminal alternative to mere arrest.

structural_cues: 42:32 repeats the 'among His signs' construction immediately after the focus.
42:33-34 sequences willing, removal of wind, stillness, and destruction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: moving ships become still when wind is withheld and may be destroyed. Reader arrow: this kinetic reversibility models creaturely gathering as control of trajectories. Live alternative: ships illustrate power independently and need not define j-m-ʿ.

changed_reading.before: Gathering relocates members of an otherwise static population.
changed_reading.after: Gathering may name command over a motion field: independently moving paths can be arrested, redirected, or made to converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated denial of return and refuge makes the willed gathering a one-way threshold: once convergence begins, neither reversal to the prior dispersed state nor an external shelter remains.

activation_trace.role: Joining separated creatures supplies the convergence whose directionality context sharpens.
Will supplies the threshold condition for initiating convergence.
The sought return supplies the reverse path that is desired but unavailable.
A bounded span of time supplies the terminal day on which reversal closes.
Repelling or turning back supplies the explicitly denied reversal.
Refuge supplies an outside position that the terminal convergence also removes.

structural_cues: 42:44 asks for a route of return; 42:47 repeats that the coming day has no turning back and no refuge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the terminal day permits neither return nor refuge. Reader arrow: the focus gathering crosses that one-way boundary. Live alternative: no-return language may qualify punishment rather than the mechanics of gathering.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is a reversible relocation selected at some time.
changed_reading.after: The selected gathering is terminal convergence: it closes both the backward route into dispersion and the lateral route into refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late reprise of creation, will, and capability distributes reproductive outcomes through gift, pairing, and sterility; the focus population is thus structured multiplicity generated through branching and blocked channels, not an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal supplies the population-level result of differentiated generative branches.
Bringing creation into existence reprises the focus creation at the start of the branching sequence.
Repeated willing selects among the generative outcomes.
Gift without exchange supplies offspring outcomes as bestowed rather than mechanically owed.
Pairing one with another supplies combination as one branch of generation.
Reproductive sterility supplies a blocked branch within the same generative control system.
Capability closes the reprise and links differentiated generation back to the focus predicate.

structural_cues: 42:49-50 reprises the focus sequence of heavens and earth, creation, repeated will, and capability.
The reprise inserts sex distribution, pairing, and sterility between creation and capability.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: creation and will produce gifted, paired, and sterile reproductive outcomes before capability is restated. Reader arrow: these are channels that generate the focus's dispersed multiplicity. Live alternative: the examples may demonstrate sovereignty without explaining b-th-th.

changed_reading.before: The scattered creatures form a generic plurality.
changed_reading.after: Their plurality is internally structured by branching generative outcomes, including both propagation and its blockage, all under the same will and capacity.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant s-m-w to w-s-m resolution rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored in the focus coupling of signs, heavens, productive earth, and broadcast life, and the rain context supplies an observable marking process. Downstream prose should present it only as a lexical activation, never as an etymological claim about 'heavens.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَثَّ فِيهِمَا

activation_trace.role: A visible mark supplies the focus's explicit sign category.
A distinguishing mark supplies the exploratory image of the upper realm as a marking agent.
First rain marking earth with vegetation supplies a concrete upper-to-lower inscription process.
Productive soft earth supplies the surface that receives and displays the mark.
Vegetation generated by rain supplies the visible trace of atmospheric action.
Revival of dry pasture supplies the transition from blank surface to legible living mark.

changed_reading.before: Heavens and earth are two created objects that contain creatures.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they become a coupled sign surface: atmospheric descent marks receptive earth with the living pattern that dispersion extends.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is cross-domain because it transfers b-th-th's disclosure of hidden content into a communicative model of creatures and signs. It remains valid as an activation because the focus explicitly joins sign, broadcast, hidden motion, and gathering, while the surah frames revelation as hidden imparting and light. Downstream prose must call it an information analogy, not claim that creatures are literally propositions or revelation.

activation_trace.role: The visible sign supplies message-bearing marks.
Disclosure and broadcast of hidden content supplies the information-like distribution mechanism.
Joining dispersed units supplies integration of distributed signals into one readable whole.
Hidden imparting supplies the surah's opening communication mode.
The repeated hidden mode at the surah's close brackets the focus within mediated communication.
Illumination supplies the conversion of hidden imparting into perceptible guidance.

changed_reading.before: The creatures are biological contents distributed through created space.
changed_reading.after: As a contained analogy, distributed lives are also sign-bearing signals whose eventual integration discloses a whole that no local observer could read.

strongest_changes: Gathering became a reversal of dispersal that also sorts trajectories without homogenizing their members.
The rain-propagation sequence turned creaturely broadcast into a recurring ecological cycle rather than a static creation inventory.
Repeated expansion, constriction, measure, and will recast capability as calibrated control of distribution and convergence.
The late creation-will-capability reprise exposed reproductive branching and sterility inside the focus's generic creaturely plurality.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly reused the focus roots in different mechanisms: communal sorting, adjudication, ecological renewal, motion arrest, reproductive branching, and terminal no-return. The focus therefore carried several coexisting scatter/gather models instead of collapsing into one final interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether gathering primarily names one terminal event or also abstracts a recurring control pattern over dispersed systems.
Whether the immediate rain-to-life sequence is materially causal or only a thematic juxtaposition of two mercies.
The celestial marking and distributed-message readings depend on explicitly contained split-root or cross-domain activations and should not be promoted to ordinary lexical claims.
